Description: Environment variables for incident response Lambda functions

Notes.EVIDENCE_BUCKET: S3 bucket for storing forensic evidence and metadata
Notes.ISOLATION_SECURITY_GROUP: Security group ID that blocks all traffic
Notes.FORENSIC_ACCOUNT_ID: Separate AWS account for forensic analysis
Notes.BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: Bedrock model used for incident classification
Notes.ROUTING_EVENT_BUS: EventBridge bus for downstream routing events
